summary: MSVC exception-throw helper for std::runtime_error. Constructs the exception object with ExceptionObjectConstructor, then raises a C++ exception with CxxThrowException8 using a local 28-byte throw-parameter frame and the std::runtime_error type-info global at 0x005BB6D8 as the throw descriptor. The nominal trailing call to ExceptionCleanupWithDestructorCall is the decompiler-emitted fallthrough after the noreturn throw.

operations.description: Construct the exception object: call ExceptionObjectConstructor(this).
Raise the C++ exception: call CxxThrowException8 with the local throw frame and the std::runtime_error type-info descriptor (global 0x005BB6D8).
Fallthrough path after the throw returns the result of ExceptionCleanupWithDestructorCall; effectively unreachable if CxxThrowException8 never returns.
